items.summary: 全线车站主体结构封顶，区间贯通，附属结构完成96%，设备安装及装修完成90%，现处于空载试运行阶段，年底基本具备开通条件。
items.summary_en: All stations topped out and intervals connected, ancillary works 96% complete, equipment and finishing 90% complete; now in no-load trial operation, basically ready for opening by year-end.

items.summary: 12号线中段（广州体育馆—二沙岛）全长8.8公里、设7座车站，土建工程已基本完工，全段轨行区已移交运营，现进入机电安装、系统调试和运营筹备阶段。按计划年底开通后，12号线将实现浔峰岗至大学城南全线贯通。
items.summary_en: The 8.8 km, 7-station middle section of Line 12 (Guangzhou Gymnasium – Ersha Island) has largely finished civil works, with the full track area handed over to operations; it is now in equipment installation, system testing and opening preparation. Once it opens by year-end as planned, Line 12 will run through from Xunfenggang to Higher Education Mega Center South.
items.title: 广州12号线中段预计2026年底开通
items.title_en: Guangzhou Line 12 (middle section) expected to open by end of 2026

items.summary: 13号线二期西段（鸦岗—天河公园）全长25.3公里、设19座车站，已于10月24日进入贯通试运行，土建基本完工、轨行区已移交运营。按计划年底开通后，13号线将实现朝阳至鱼珠全线贯通，有助于分担5号线东西向通勤压力。
items.summary_en: The 25.3 km, 19-station western section of Line 13 Phase 2 (Yagang – Tianhe Park) entered through trial running on 24 October, with civil works largely complete and the track area handed over. Once it opens by year-end as planned, Line 13 will run through from Chaoyang to Yuzhu, easing east–west commuter pressure on Line 5.
items.title: 广州13号线二期西段预计2026年底开通
items.title_en: Guangzhou Line 13 Phase 2 (west section) expected to open by end of 2026

items.summary: 27003车、27004车已于近日运抵璧山停车场并完成吊装落轨，车辆接收取得阶段性进展，为后续车辆调试、全线联调联试打下基础。27号线全长约56公里、设15座车站，设计时速140公里，仍按计划推进，预计2027年开通。
items.summary_en: Trains 27003 and 27004 have arrived at the Bishan depot and been lifted onto the tracks, a milestone in vehicle delivery ahead of testing and full-line joint commissioning. Line 27 runs about 56 km with 15 stations at a design speed of 140 km/h, and remains on schedule for a 2027 opening.

items.summary: 11月19日，合肥轨道S1线（合肥段）省中医院西区站至新桥2号航站楼站区段正式开通初期运营，安全评估等各项开通筹备工作已全部完成。作为市域快线，S1线着力打造一站式智慧出行体系，将大幅缩短合肥主城区与新桥国际机场之间的通勤时间。
items.summary_en: On 19 November, the Hefei section of Line S1 (Shengzhongyiyuan West Zone – Xinqiao Terminal 2) entered initial operation, with all safety assessments and opening preparations complete. As a suburban express line built around one-stop smart travel, it will sharply cut travel time between central Hefei and Xinqiao International Airport.
items.title: 合肥S1线（合肥段）今日开通初期运营
items.title_en: Hefei Line S1 (Hefei section) opens for trial operation today

items.summary: 11月12日，重庆轨道交通15号线井口至两江影视城段开通初期运营，全长47.9公里，采用全自动运行模式。作为重庆首条城轨快线，15号线串联起西部科学城与两江新区，将有效缓解沿线通勤压力。
items.summary_en: On 12 November, the Jingkou – Liangjiang Movie City section of Chongqing Line 15 entered initial operation. The 47.9 km section runs in fully automatic mode. As Chongqing's first urban rail express line, Line 15 links the Western Science City with Liangjiang New Area and will ease commuter pressure along the route.
items.title: 重庆15号线井口至两江影视城段开通初期运营
items.title_en: Chongqing Line 15 (Jingkou – Liangjiang Movie City) opens for trial operation

items.summary: 据吉林省发展和改革委员会消息，长春轨道交通1号线南延工程已进入空载试运行阶段，采取分段开通方案：先期段红石、兴创路、兴博路、兴启路4站计划2026年底开通，柳家、永春南两站计划2027年底开通。南延线全长7公里，沿人民大街向南延伸，将扩大1号线服务范围，优化南部区域公共交通体系。
items.summary_en: According to the Jilin Provincial Development and Reform Commission, the south extension of Changchun Line 1 has entered no-load trial operation and will open in stages: the first four stations (Hongshi, Xingchuanglu, Xingbolu, Xingqilu) are planned to open by the end of 2026, with Liujia and Yongchunnan to follow by the end of 2027. The 7 km extension runs south along Renmin Avenue, widening Line 1's coverage and improving public transport in the city's south.
items.title: 长春1号线南延进入空载试运行，先期段预计年底开通
items.title_en: Changchun Line 1 south extension enters trial operation; first section expected by year-end

items.summary: 11月3日起，深圳地铁13号线启用新版运营组织方案，早高峰增加上线列车、压缩行车间隔，德雅路站至后海站区间最小行车间隔压缩至3分钟，高峰运能提升约25%。此举将疏解早高峰客流、缩短乘客候车时间，进一步优化沿线通勤出行体验。
items.summary_en: From 3 November, Shenzhen Line 13 runs a new operating plan for the morning peak: more trains in service and shorter headways, with the minimum interval between Deyalu and Houhai cut to 3 minutes and peak capacity up about 25%. The change eases peak crowding and shortens waits for commuters along the line.
items.title: 深圳13号线11月3日起早高峰提速
items.title_en: Shenzhen Line 13 boosts morning peak service from 3 November
